title: Sign version of the fundamental lemma: nonnegative pairing with all nonnegative C¹_c tests forces f ≥ 0 a.e.
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and f : ℝⁿ → ℝ be locally Lebesgue integrable. Suppose ∫ g(x) f(x) dLⁿ(x) ≥ 0 for every C¹ function g : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support and g ≥ 0 everywhere. Then f(x) ≥ 0 for Lⁿ-almost every x ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable f volume → (∀ g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → 0 ≤ ∫ x, g x * f x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ f x
